subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

Hang up your boots

options.text: take good care of your shoes
be tired and go to sleep early

solution:
The correct answer is: **retire from playing a game**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The idiom '**Hang up your boots**' means to stop playing a sport, especially football, and retire.

 
 
• Example- *I want a few triumphs and medals to reflect on when I eventually **hang up my boots__**.*
 
 
 
• So, it is clear that the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom '**Hang up your boots****​**' is '**retire from playing a game**'

Hence, the correct answer is option 3.
